name: OpenWrt
description: Reads an OpenWrt router or access point: the router itself as a network node, and every device it knows as a client: DHCP leases and neighbours (wired), and the Wi-Fi stations that are associated with each radio, with band, signal strength (RSSI) and link speed. Netlens uses this to place devices in the hierarchy and to show Wi-Fi signal history and roaming. Read-only: it only calls a few read functions through the router's ubus web interface.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: The health of the router: processor, memory, load, temperature, uptime, the OpenWrt version, and the network devices as ports with link, speed and counters; the internet interface is named WAN. New setting Read the health of the devices; the login needs two extra ACL lines for processor and temperature (see the box on the plugin's page). Needs Netlens 0.4.237.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
